topic: A two-question tech quiz about memory and graphics card names
title: Tech Quiz: Can You Pass These Two? #siliconverdict #techquiz #pcbuild
description: Two quick questions about RAM speed and graphics card names, each with the answer and the reason.
pinned_comment: Question one or two? Reply with one word.

scenes.narration: Most people get the second question wrong, and the first one is easy.
Stay for the second one, because the answer is hiding in the name.
Question one. Which is faster: A, an SSD, B, RAM, or C, both the same?
RAM answers in about a hundred nanoseconds, while an SSD needs far longer.
That gap is roughly a thousand times, which is why programs live in RAM.
Question two. In RTX 4090 Ti, does Ti mean titanium, turbo, or tier one?
Nvidia uses Ti for titanium, the name of its faster mid-generation tier.
So now the rest of a graphics card name is easier to read.
Every product name hides a clue, once you know the code.
Share this with the friend who always guesses.
